scope: Consumer/allocation read-only review plus root-delegated strict-reader correction in two Python tools; no repeated OVMF execution
head: 93286527c9624d4ca8d46d2c4221fa58a4aa0854

findings.problem: Secondary checker accepted a failed envelope, eight duplicates of one case and absent envelope while reporting success
findings.resolution: Shared successful envelope validator requires actual raw serial agreement, complete ordered8-case matrix, recomputed validations, marker grammar and scope/hash fields; checker fails explicitly without Python asserts

findings.problem: Host numeric fields admitted 2^64 and overflowing host spans
findings.resolution: All host bases and exclusive ends must fit u64 before disjointness checks

verified: ArmPages owns aligned initialized LoaderData/LoaderCode allocations and validates map type/range before exposing slices
Host RAM/table/code extents and guest RAM/table extents checked disjoint; no host pointer used as guest PA
Ledger reservations supply actual placement; stale generation is rejected before the sole C JIT call without RAM changes
Serialized source identity/template replacement and structural offset are checked before typed DT commit
Scoped synchronous service holds exclusive RAM and immutable table borrow through real native entry
Firmware compares complete RAM to expected image, table/source preservation, precise fault/control/counters and restored code permissions
Independent reader decodes exact DT schema and recomputes full RAM SHA from guard/code/wire/output placement
limits: This review reuses prior actual x86 OVMF raw evidence; it does not execute new EFI or physical hardware
Detailed invalid-case ELR/SPSR/leaf level/fault_instruction are enforced inside the reviewed firmware predicate but not separately printed as raw CASE fields
Historical input digests are recorded provenance; upgraded checker does not claim original runner equals its current source
No production boot, original DT provider/ABI, macOS acceptance or guest Metal claim
